name: get_tld_price
description:
Get base price data for a TLD for a given number of years; defaults to the TLD's minimum term. Premium domains may be priced differently; use get_domain_price for a specific domain.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/registrar/tlds/{tld}/price --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

years.description: The number of years to get the price for. If not provided, the minimum number of years for the TLD will be used.
